title: Tiny, cute guitar
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g transform='rotate(-20 50 50)'>
    <!-- neck -->
    <rect x='45' y='12' width='10' height='36' rx='4' fill='#c98a3e'/>
    <rect x='45' y='12' width='4' height='36' rx='2' fill='#e8b36b'/>
    <!-- headstock -->
    <rect x='43' y='6' width='14' height='10' rx='3' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
    <circle cx='47' cy='9' r='1.5' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
    <circle cx='53' cy='9' r='1.5' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
    <circle cx='47' cy='13' r='1.5' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
    <circle cx='53' cy='13' r='1.5' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='26' ry='23' fill='#f5a94e'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='63' rx='19' ry='16' fill='#ffc97a'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='17' ry='12' fill='#e08e3a'/>
    <!-- sound hole -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='64' r='7' fill='#7a3f12'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='64' r='4.5' fill='#5c2c08'/>
    <!-- bridge -->
    <rect x='40' y='80' width='20' height='5' rx='2' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
    <rect x='40' y='80' width='20' height='2' rx='1' fill='#b57a3e'/>
    <!-- strings -->
    <line x1='47' y1='16' x2='47' y2='81' stroke='#fff4d0' stroke-width='1'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='16' x2='50' y2='81' stroke='#fff4d0' stroke-width='1'/>
    <line x1='53' y1='16' x2='53' y2='81' stroke='#fff4d0' stroke-width='1'/>
    <!-- pickguard -->
    <path d='M56 60 Q70 62 68 74 Q64 84 54 82 Q60 74 56 60 Z' fill='#ffe08a' opacity='0.9'/>
    <!-- cute eyes on body -->
    <circle cx='38' cy='70' r='2.6' fill='#3a1c06'/>
    <circle cx='62' cy='70' r='2.6' fill='#3a1c06'/>
    <circle cx='38.8' cy='69.2' r='0.9' fill='#fff'/>
    <circle cx='62.8' cy='69.2' r='0.9' fill='#fff'/>
    <path d='M45 74 Q50 78 55 74' stroke='#3a1c06' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- cheeks -->
    <circle cx='32' cy='75' r='2.5' fill='#ff8f7a' opacity='0.8'/>
    <circle cx='68' cy='75' r='2.5' fill='#ff8f7a' opacity='0.8'/>
  </g>
</svg>
